This page documents mallard duck movement over time.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

duck_data <- data.frame(
  day = 1:5,
  ducks = c(12, 18, 25, 20, 31)
)

ggplot(duck_data, aes(day, ducks)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2b7a78") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2b7a78") +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Duck Counts",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of ducks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv")

head(mallards, 10)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    min_lat = min(lat),
    max_lat = max(lat),
    min_lon = min(long),
    max_lon = max(long)
  )
```
